concept.title: Ears Out, Pom-Pom On
concept.hook: First second: a gray tabby sits on a window seat, a mustard beanie with a small pom-pom already on, ears popping through the two openings. Overlay: Your cat just found out she looks incredible.
concept.surpriseBeat: The tabby catches her reflection in the dark window glass, pauses, then lifts her chin and slowly turns her head to show off the pom-pom.

locations.description: cozy miniature living room with a knit throw draped over a window seat, muted teal wall behind
locations.lighting: soft warm key light with gentle rim light on fur and yarn

locations.description: soft cream backdrop with a yarn-ball prop, clean empty floor
locations.lighting: soft even key light with gentle rim light

scenes.action: Gray tabby sits on the window seat wearing the mustard beanie, ears through the openings, big expressive eyes blinking once.
scenes.framing: Centered close shot of the cat's head and beanie, shallow depth of field, vertical safe zone
scenes.motion: Ears twitch through the openings, pom-pom bobs with a squash and stretch blink
scenes.lighting: Warm key with soft rim light, teal background
scenes.overlayText: Your cat just found out she looks incredible.
scenes.sound: Ukulele pluck starts, soft wool squish on the blink

scenes.action: Side view shows the two ear openings and the stitched texture of the mustard knit as the cat settles on the knit throw.
scenes.framing: Medium close, cat centered, visible stitches and fuzzy fibers
scenes.motion: Cat turns her head slowly, pom-pom swaying
scenes.lighting: Soft key, subsurface glow on fur and yarn
scenes.dialogue: Soft stretch yarn, made to sit just right.
scenes.sound: Light hand claps on the beat, glockenspiel accent

scenes.action: The cat glances toward the window glass and notices her reflection, eyes widening.
scenes.framing: Cat in profile with faint reflection in the glass, centered
scenes.lighting: Warm interior light against muted teal dusk
scenes.sound: Music dips to bass and shuffle, tiny whistle hook

scenes.action: The cat lifts her chin and slowly turns her head, showing off the pom-pom like she planned it.
scenes.framing: Tight on face and beanie, centered
scenes.motion: Chin lifts, eyes half close in a smug blink, pom-pom bounces
scenes.lighting: Rim light flares on the yarn fuzz
scenes.overlayText: Ears out, pom-pom on, zero complaints.
scenes.sound: Whistle hook lands with a boop effect

scenes.action: Clean shot of the mustard beanie folded with the rust-red sweater, paw tag facing camera, yarn ball beside them.
scenes.framing: Centered product shot, full stack visible, tag facing camera
scenes.motion: Still, only the yarn ball rolls a little and stops
scenes.lighting: Soft even key on cream backdrop
scenes.dialogue: Small cats to large dogs, new colors each season. Shop now, $24.
scenes.sound: Music resolves with glockenspiel and a last hand clap

rubric.reason: Strong smug payoff built on the brief's own hook and the ear openings. The reflection moment is charming but gentle; product is worn throughout.

concept.title: Click, Stretch, Strut
concept.hook: First second: a rust-red sweater springs into shape over a fluffy dog's back with a wool squish. Overlay: Tiny sweater. Big main character energy.
concept.surpriseBeat: The small terrier in the second beanie trots into frame and falls in step behind the sweater dog, copying his strut exactly.

locations.description: tiny autumn porch with scattered leaves and a pumpkin, muted teal wall
locations.lighting: low warm key with soft rim light

locations.description: soft cream backdrop with a yarn-ball prop
locations.lighting: soft even key with gentle rim light

scenes.action: The rust-red knit sweater stretches over a fluffy medium dog's back and springs into shape.
scenes.framing: Tight on the dog's back and shoulders, centered
scenes.motion: Knit stretches then snaps back with squash and stretch
scenes.lighting: Warm key with rim glow on stitches
scenes.overlayText: Tiny sweater. Big main character energy.
scenes.sound: Wool squish effect on the beat, ukulele pluck

scenes.action: The adjustable strap on the mustard beanie clicks snug under the chin of a small terrier waiting beside the pumpkin.
scenes.framing: Medium close on terrier's face, strap visible under chin
scenes.motion: Terrier tilts head, ears wiggle, tail wags
scenes.lighting: Soft warm key, leaves glowing behind

scenes.action: The sweater dog struts along the porch past the pumpkin, leaves kicking up behind him.
scenes.framing: Full body, centered in safe zone
scenes.motion: Bouncy confident strut with squash and stretch on each step
scenes.lighting: Golden hour key with rim light
scenes.sound: Shuffle groove with warm bass steps

scenes.action: The terrier in the beanie trots into frame and copies the strut exactly, a step behind.
scenes.framing: Wide, both dogs centered on the porch
scenes.motion: Matching steps, heads held high, leaves tumble
scenes.sound: Whistle hook, glockenspiel hit on the second dog's entrance

scenes.action: Sweater and beanie sit folded together, paw tag facing camera, yarn ball beside them.
scenes.framing: Centered product shot, tag toward camera
scenes.motion: Still, with a tiny yarn ball rolling to rest
scenes.dialogue: Machine washable and made for the whole family. Shop now, $24.
scenes.sound: Music resolves with a final hand clap

rubric.reason: The sweater spring is a bold opening and the click shows the real product use. The copycat strut is a clear single escalation with good rhythm.

concept.title: A Tiny Day in Knits
concept.hook: First second: a mustard beanie lands on a gray tabby's head from above, ears pop through the openings. Overlay: Ears out, pom-pom on, zero complaints.
concept.surpriseBeat: The tabby, the dog and the terrier all end up asleep in a heap on the window seat in their knits, the dog's chest rising in time with the music.

locations.description: cozy miniature living room with a knit throw and a window seat, muted teal wall
locations.lighting: soft warm window light with gentle rim light

locations.description: soft cream backdrop with a yarn-ball prop

scenes.action: The mustard beanie drops onto the tabby's head and the ears pop through the openings.
scenes.framing: Tight centered on the cat's head, vertical safe zone
scenes.motion: Ears squash through the openings, pom-pom bounces
scenes.overlayText: Ears out, pom-pom on, zero complaints.

scenes.action: The fluffy dog stands still while the rust-red sweater stretches over his back and springs into shape.
scenes.framing: Starts at paws, tilts up to the sweater, centered
scenes.motion: Sweater snaps into place, dog gives a happy shake
scenes.lighting: Warm key, fiber glow on yarn
scenes.dialogue: Soft stretch yarn that springs right back.

scenes.action: The terrier in a second beanie wiggles across the rug, pom-pom swinging, then hops up on the knit throw.
scenes.motion: Wiggly bouncy trot with squash and stretch

scenes.action: All three pets pile onto the window seat and fall asleep in their knits, the dog's chest rising slowly.
scenes.framing: Starts close on the sleeping tabby, pulls back to the whole heap
scenes.lighting: Warm light fades slightly toward golden
scenes.overlayText: Sizes for small cats to large dogs
scenes.sound: Music softens to ukulele and a soft whistle

scenes.action: Beanie and sweater sit folded together, paw tag facing camera.
scenes.framing: Centered clean product shot, tag toward camera
scenes.overlayText: New colors each season. Shop now, $24
scenes.dialogue: New colors each season. Shop now, $24.
scenes.sound: Final glockenspiel note and hand clap

rubric.reason: Very clear cozy emotion and every piece is worn through the day. The nap pile is sweet but predictable, and the hook is softer than the others.
